About Eppix Labs

Built on Documentation.
Not Claims.

Eppix Labs was built on one principle: if a purity claim is on the label, there needs to be a verifiable third-party result behind it. Every batch independently tested, every result publicly linked, every COA batch-matched and downloadable.

Our Philosophy

Documentation as the Foundation

Every compound in our catalog is analysed by an independent third-party laboratory before release. Those laboratories have no operational connection to us, and the full report for each lot is published rather than summarised.

Results are published and linked from each product page. Any researcher can verify a batch result on the Janoshik portal without contacting us.

Documentation is not a feature — it is the structure the entire operation is built around. Test results, COA records, batch references, verification links. All of it accessible, all of it batch-specific.

Independent, not in-house

Every batch is sent to an independent third-party laboratory — Janoshik Analytical for almost every lot. We do not self-certify. Independence is the point.

Publicly linked, not PDF-only

Every COA is linked directly to the issuing laboratory’s verification portal. Any researcher can verify the result independently.

Every batch is documented

Every product is assigned a batch-specific lot reference. That reference is published on the product page, tied to the Certificate of Analysis, and verifiable directly on the Janoshik portal.

Verification Standard

The Eppix Verification Standard

Every batch is independently analysed by a third-party laboratory before it is released, and the report for that lot is published in full rather than summarised. Two figures are published, not one: purity, and measured content against the labelled amount.

Purity tells you what fraction of the material in a vial is the compound on the label. It tells you nothing about how much material is in the vial — a vial can be highly pure and still be short. Both numbers are published for every Eppix lot, whichever way they fall, and each is tied to the lot code printed on the vial.

Our Standards

What We Stand For

Analytical Integrity

A purity claim means nothing without the data to back it. Every compound in our catalog has a batch-specific COA from an independent laboratory. Purity is confirmed by HPLC and mass spectrometry.

Traceability First

Every product is assigned a lot reference before distribution — published on the product page and matched to a specific COA. The path runs through publicly accessible records: product page to COA to Janoshik verification portal.

Transparency

Every COA is linked directly to the issuing laboratory’s verification portal. Any researcher can verify the result independently — no downloads required, no trusting the document we provide.

Research First

Our products are supplied exclusively for laboratory research within the United States. We do not provide dosing guidance, administration instructions, or any information that frames our compounds outside a research context.

U.S. Operations

We operate out of the United States. Shipping is domestic, discreet, and tracked.

No Invented Specifications

We don't publish purity figures we haven't tested for. We don't use COA images from previous batches on new stock. Every specification reflects a real, current, verifiable test result.

The Standard

What Every Order Is Built On

These aren't aspirational commitments. They're operational decisions that apply to every batch, every product, every order we ship.

✓

Batch-specific documentation

Every COA maps to a single, identified lot. The lot reference is published on the product page and linked to the Janoshik verification record — so the documentation chain is established for every batch we list.

✓

Independently verified results

Purity results come from third-party laboratories with no operational connection to Eppix Labs. The Janoshik verification link on each product page opens the result directly on their portal.

✓

Research framing, without exception

Our products are for laboratory research. That framing appears on every product page, every order confirmation, and every piece of documentation we publish.

✓

Specifications you can verify

Every purity figure, batch number, and test result listed on our site reflects a real, current, verifiable analysis. If a number is on our product page, there is a batch-specific Janoshik record behind it.
